Roles & Responsibilities
About the Company
I am currently partnering with an established technology company. They focus on building scalable data infrastructure and web-based tools to support complex, growing business needs.
About the Job
Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT data pipelines and efficient ingestion frameworks across diverse data sources.
Implement Change Data Capture (CDC), smart partitioning, and incremental loads; implement CI/CD automation for pipeline monitoring and version control.
Architect modern data warehouses and data lakes, designing scalable dimensional models (star and snowflake schemas) and managing data mart evolution.
Establish automated data validation frameworks, lineage tracking, and alerting systems to ensure high data integrity and data protection compliance.
Continuously optimize cloud storage and compute resource utilization while ensuring system reliability, high availability, and disaster recovery.
Skills and Requirements
Mandarin speaking required as you need to liaise with Chinese counterparts who can only speak and write in Mandarin.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Big Data development.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or a closely related discipline.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL.
AWS: Proven experience with Glue, Redshift, S3, Athena, Lambda, EMR, and Step Functions.
Databases: Skilled in both Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB).
To apply online please use the 'apply' function, alternatively you may contact Evangeline. (EA: 94C3609/ R24124002)

About the Company
Randstad is a global talent leader with the vision to be the world’s most equitable and specialised talent company. As a partner for talent and through our four specialisations - Operational, Professional, Digital and Enterprise - we provide clients with the high-quality, diverse and agile workforces that they need to succeed in a talent scarce world. We help people secure meaningful roles, develop relevant skills and find purpose and belonging in their workplace. Through the value we create, we are committed to a better and more sustainable future for all.
